status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; no device reads this file yet. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: A design the build module can implement and verify: the architecture decisions with the constraints they hold under and the alternatives rejected, and a verification design that says how each acceptance criterion is verified and which failure mode each verification catches.

previous_feature_design.note: The previous_* documents and the material they are for are given on a re-run.

rules.rule: On a re-run, each output document the run changes is the previous document unchanged, then one appended section "## Delta — round <n>", n being the number of delta sections in the previous document plus one; what the round is for, the module states from its inputs (Q13). "## Decision requests" is the exception: rewritten in place to its current state.

entries.note: the id names the item in the verification design's table

tables.locate: the table whose header row's first cell is "Item", outside every "## Delta — round <n>" section

rows.rule: a row carries its disposition — at least one cell after Item is not empty

coverage.rule: every AC id of applied_criteria, and every id of an included item of the feature design's "## Scope", has at least one row
coverage.source: docs/evaluation-system.md > GATE:PLAN > AC-authority check; docs/units/design.md > Output artifacts (the Issue AC bullet)

tables.note: Every item the work owes has a disposition: each applied acceptance criterion and each item the feature design's "## Scope" includes (Q8, Q14). How an item is verified, or why it is not, is the module's judgment in its own words. The table the first run wrote is the one outside every "## Delta — round <n>" section: a re-run appends a delta and leaves that table as it stands (docs/units/design.md > Re-entry).
